digest.component_or_area: RP-04 operation-scoped configuration and provider-auth binding architecture
propositions: ADR 0098 must record the approved decision: Rebar composes immutable non-secret operation configuration with separately owned provider-auth/runtime bindings at application boundaries.
Every external dependency and OSS behavior claim in ADR 0098 requires specific primary-source or repository research citations; Rebar probe claims must cite durable research artifacts.
ADR 0098 must narrow ADR 0049 only at per-job retrieval/composition and explicitly preserve all unaffected decisions including Ed25519/DSSE protocol, trust roots, producer, and SSM-at-rest choice.

The ADR must document operation-snapshot precedence, provider-native pre-client auth injection, static restart/redeploy rotation, fail-closed auth decision-bearing, and op-cert startup with exactly one key source and no hot reload.
ADR 0098 status transitions from Proposed/Draft through numbered critique and maintainer review to Accepted, with no RP-04 implementation code permitted before explicit authorization.
The ADR generator produces conflict-free numbering and index artifacts; all mechanical checks and conflict-marker searches must pass before merge.
